name: lumi-skill-design-studio-pack
description: Compatible creative briefs, brand/UI review and visual directions, plus bounded interior planning, drawing QA, FF&E, site-survey, IFC and Revit review plans.

lumi.setupNote: All eleven analysis/planning tools work without API keys. Optional rendering and read-only BIM connectors remain separately configured capabilities.

limitations: The tools analyze supplied project facts and prepare plans; they do not alter drawings, applications, or external systems.
